The tail end tapers to a fine rootlet point, straight and uncurled. Views: the side view shows the whole body lying straight and flat along its length. The front view, with the head end toward the viewer, shows the rounded root-tip end foreshortened, with tiny eyes in the fuzz. The rear view, seen from behind, shows the tapering tail end and the knobbly body receding. The creature is compact, and its silhouette stays readable at small size.
